name: Assala
description:
'''Assala Mostafa Hatem Nasri''' ({{langx|ar|أصالة مصطفى حاتم نصري}}; born 15 May 1969), mononymously known as '''Assala''' ({{langx|ar|أصالة}}), is a [[Syrians|Syrian]] singer. 

Assala Nasri is widely regarded as one of the Arab world’s most influential and admired celebrities. Her career includes more than 25 albums, along with numerous successful singles and music videos that have accumulated millions of views on YouTube. Assala has established a lasting legacy in Arabic music, influencing younger generations of Arab singers through her vocal ability, emotional expression, and commitment to her work. Her songs remain popular across the Arab world, featuring regularly at weddings, concerts, and on music playlists.
